The BAU investigates the cause of several fatal car crashes involving drivers and pedestrians. Also, Reid gets bad news. (TV-14 L, V)
When several women go missing in Virginia, the BAU must figure out what they have in common in order to find them.
It's literally a race against the clock for the BAU to capture the vigilantes behind a series of attacks taking place every 27 minutes in the nation's capital.
When Reid fears his mother has been abducted, he asks the BAU to investigate while he's stuck in prison. (TV-14 L, V)

When Kate's niece Meg and her best friend are kidnapped, the BAU suspects an online predator engaged in sex trafficking.
